propositions: Close gate verification fails when evidence search exhausts its step budget without refuting any criterion, but the verdict cache banks credited PASSes so a re-run would succeed on the same input, yet currently this requires manual operator intervention

The gate should automatically re-run verification (bounded by auto_resume_max, default 2) when a FAIL is insufficiency-only (every unmet criterion lacks evidence via the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker) instead of surfacing the failure to the operator

Auto-resumption must be gated by strict progress: a resumption dispatches only when the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count; zero progress stops the loop early and surfaces the failure

The resumption loop sits at the shared close-gate seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck calling llm.verify_completion) so it is exercised by CLI, MCP, and library closes (all via transition_close.close_ticket)
Each resumption attempt must be logged with attempt number, cache-credited PASS count, and remaining unmet criteria, visible in close output and attached to the durable COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar

The resumption implementation reuses the existing _insufficiency_only predicate unchanged, requires no schema or prompt changes, and surfaces failure states honestly (including attempt counts) when bounded resumptions are exhausted
